create.title: New calendar

permissions.description: What people may do with their own events and what group members get by default.

levels.explain: What do the access levels mean?

free_busy.label: Free/busy
free_busy.hint: Sees only when someone is busy, no titles or details.

read.label: View
read.hint: Sees all events with their details.

contribute.label: Add events
contribute.hint: Views everything and adds own events; cannot change others' events.

manage.label: Manage
manage.hint: Edits events and changes settings and sharing.

owner.label: Owner
owner.hint: Manages and may delete the calendar.

sharing.title: Sharing
